THE EARLIER 'palm only works within 20 minutes' CONCLUSION WAS AN ARTEFACT OF THAT BAD DATA: time is not the variable - a 27-hour pair scores 0.84 while two shots 36 seconds apart score 0.73. What varies is hand pose, and max-over-anchors is what absorbs it, which is exactly why enrolling several DIFFERENT presentations matters. identify_margin 0.08 guards 1:N look-alikes; dupe_threshold 0.78 sits above the 0.6462 impostor ceiling so a real person is never refused as someone else's duplicate.
